amendment_reason: User requires explicit connection to the original blood triage framework, not only the later brain tau manuscript.
original_framework: Frozen eight blood-expression modules, clinical AD versus control endpoint, cohort shift, probability calibration and defer/review decisions
brain_tau_panel_role: orthogonal tissue context; not a substitute primary clinical blood outcome
protein_primary_candidate: donor-level mean of log1p H3-normalized measured microglial nuclear NF-kappaB
H3_cell_quality_gate: H3 ADT greater than 1, following author technical gate; protein nonmissing, inCITE preparation only
aliquot_qc_amendment_before_model_result: Identical bank/region/age/sex/disease with repeated aliquots: keep one donor, nucleus-weight RIN/PMI covariates and retain source ranges; do not split the person. Identity conflicts stop analysis.

immune_extension.method: MCP-counter relative marker abundance, using markers common to the three chip cohorts
primary_questions: Are M01/M07 associations with monocytic and neutrophil scores retained after removing overlapping signature genes?
Are frozen-classifier errors and deferral enriched at discovery-defined immune-score extremes in external cohorts?
immune_extension.extreme_cutoffs: two-sided discovery 5th/95th percentiles; trained reference only
immune_extension.marker_coverage_amendment_before_results: Groups with fewer than two markers common to all three chip cohorts are not scored; retain their coverage failures; error gate uses only the two prespecified myeloid groups.
immune_extension.statistical_family: BH over prespecified M01/M07 x monocytic/neutrophil x three-cohort partial association tests; error enrichment tests separately Holm corrected
immune_extension.association_adjustment: diagnosis, age and recorded sex when identifiable; no external classifier refit
immune_extension.mask_rule: remove all eight immune marker genes from frozen modules but retain original module denominator; unchanged classifier is a sensitivity mapping, not a replacement model

genetic_extension.gate: usable public cis-eQTL/pQTL, matched alleles/build/ancestry, strength and sample-overlap audit, locus-wide colocalization, LD-aware inference

virtual_knockout_extension.role: secondary regulatory-network hypothesis testing on donor-balanced microglial nuclei
virtual_knockout_extension.evaluation: direction and stability of changes to prespecified M01/M07-related genes and protein-predictor features; experimental perturbation benchmark if matching data exist

finite_first_round: real paired-data extraction plus original-triage immune error audit; instrument-access audit before MR and network simulation
